notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 2) reporting results of an issuer EXCHANGE offer (Rule 13e-4) for the fund's own Auction Rate Preferred Shares (Series B and C Auction Market Preferred, Series E Auction Rate Preferred), not its common shares. Consideration: 0.96 of a newly issued Series J Cumulative Term Preferred Share (liquidation preference $25,000) per ARPS, plus cash in lieu of fractional shares; the fee table values this at 96% of the $25,000 liquidation preference ($24,000 per share). price_basis=other (percent of liquidation preference, paid in new preferred shares); price_pct_nav and final_price_per_share are null because no NAV-based or cash per-share price is stated. size_pct_outstanding=100: 'up to 100%' of the ARPS; size_shares=6,371 from the fee-calculation footnote (maximum shares in the exchange offer). CONFLICT: the Schedule TO body (doc 1, Rule 13e-4(c)(4) results) says 6,105 ARPS were tendered and all 6,105 (95.8% of outstanding) accepted; the press release (doc 2) says tenders for 96% of outstanding and '6,106 Auction Rate Preferred Shares tendered'. Used doc 1 (6,105). proration_factor_pct=100 because the filing says ALL tendered shares were accepted (stated in words, not as a percent). subject_tickers: GDV is the ticker printed for the trust (its common shares); the preferred shares in the offer have no ticker printed. Press release: 5,817 Series J shares to be issued on or about April 20, 2021 and $1,119,000 cash in lieu of fractions. Conditions, proration and the offer's purpose are not stated in this amendment.
